column1: # Each config checks one temporal property (Converges); TLC v1.7.4 prints its violation without the name.
# ci: each under 30 s with 4 workers (TLC v1.7.4).
# As built, with the hourly read: every fault class, a rollback of both DOs included
# As built, by nudges alone (no hourly read): lost replies and resets; a CatalogDO-only rollback
# Without the hourly read, a rolled-back AgentDO drops a read it owed: the hourly read is load-bearing
# Mutations and the bug before review: each must be caught
# The answer deletes the row at any rev, so a stale answer drops a newer nudge
# Review finding 1: a rollback's run consumed the storage alarm, and nothing sets it again (MC_old_fixed is its control)
